people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
translations.bsb: And because God helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, that they sacrificed seven bullocks and seven rams.
